title: Slushie Bar Xtra Island Bliss 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Island Bliss transports your taste buds to a tropical paradise with a vibrant blend of exotic fruits. This e-liquid combines a medley of sweet, juicy fruits, each offering its own distinct flavour that mingles harmoniously for a truly bright and refreshing vape. Perfect for those who love fruity blends with a tropical twist, Island Bliss provides a smooth and satisfying vaping experience that’s both full-bodied and refreshingly light. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
